name: Alice-chanchi ni Isourou!
original_name: アリスちゃんちに居候っ!
source:
Having somehow strayed into the demonic realm, you've got to stay at little Al*ce's house.
A novel game where you enjoy lovey-dovey with not only alice but alto Sh*nki-sama and Y*meko-chan!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE103304.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你不知为何误入魔界，只能住进小爱丽丝的家。在这款小说游戏中，你不仅能和爱丽丝，也能和阿尔托、申树大人及梦子酱享受甜蜜时光！

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE103304.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
